articles.summary: It’s almost the time of year when the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) publishes its annual cyber threat report, so it’s a great opportunity to reflect on cybercrime and what the new report may highlight. The 2020–2021 report was published last September and is based on data sets of cybercrime reports and cyber security incidents in Australia that were reported to the ACSC. The report noted that there was a 13% increase over the previous year in both cybercrime activity and severity and impact, with almost 50% rated as “substantial.”
